notes: Hand-maintained overlay for go_fixture_manifest.json; pbs-devtools adapter-manifest merges it and validates it.

runs: keyed "<go_pkg>/<go_test>". setup must equal the statements the generator detects, opaque_fields the struct-literal fields it cannot evaluate, and go_test_file_sha256 the SHA-256 of go_test_file; any mismatch fails generation until the entry is re-reviewed against the Go test.
hooks vocabulary: clock_utc (RFC 3339 UTC), random_int63, random_intn, uuid, testing_flag, cache_buster, week, package_vars ({Go name: value}), version_ver.
expected_totals: what the Go tree must produce; update after reviewing added or removed adapters and fixtures.

adnuntius/TestJsonSamples.notes: adnuntius_test.go:44-49 AssignDefaultValues replaces adapter.time with a FakeTime fixed at time.Date(2016, 1, 1, 12, 30, 15, 0, time.UTC); assertTzo only asserts the field is set.

appnexus/TestJsonSamples.notes: appnexus_test.go:22-23 replaces adapter.randomGenerator; FakeRandomNumberGenerator (appnexus_test.go:46-55) returns Number (10) from both GenerateInt63() and Intn(n).

cadent_aperture_mx/TestJsonSamples.notes: cadentaperturemx_test.go:24-27 sets adapter.testing = true; buildEndpoint (cadentaperturemx.go:26-34) then returns endpoint + "?t=1000&ts=2060541160" instead of using the request tmax and time.Now().

eplanning/TestJsonSamples.notes: eplanning_test.go:24-27 sets EPlanningAdapter.testing = true; MakeRequests (eplanning.go:173-180) then sends body "{}" and omits the rnd query parameter (rand.Int()).

flipp/TestJsonSamples.notes: flipp_test.go:37-40 replaces adapter.uuidGenerator with TestUUIDGenerator, whose Generate() returns fakeUuid (flipp_test.go:15) and a nil error.

sharethrough/TestJsonSamples.notes: sharethrough_test.go:12 assigns the package var adapterVersion (declared "10.0" in sharethrough.go:18, so the value is unchanged today); it is sent as source.ext.str next to version.Ver.

smaato/TestJsonSamples.notes: smaato_test.go:28-30 replaces adapter.clock (timeutil.Time) with a mockTime fixed at 2021-06-25T10:00:00Z; smaato.go:288 uses it for bid expiry.

yieldlab/TestJsonSamples.notes: yieldlab_test.go:16-32 builds &YieldlabAdapter{endpoint: testURL, cacheBuster: testCacheBuster, getWeek: testWeekGenerator} without Builder; testCacheBuster returns "testing" and testWeekGenerator returns "33". There is no bidder name.
